name: Halcyon Gauge
tagline: A private archive of hydrographic instruments for working oceanographers

twists.color: Dark silt-amber palette inverted to light register. Parchment #f5f0e8 base. Amber-clay #b85c2a as sole chromatic accent.
twists.type: Replaced Quicksand (rounded geometric) with Cormorant Garamond (high-contrast editorial serif) for headings. Unexpected high/low pairing against warm Nunito body.
twists.motion: Replaced fadeInUp with clip-path curtain reveal (inset 100%→0%). Instrument cover removal metaphor.
twists.grid: Built complete 12-column editorial grid from near-empty caitlin-christinee source. Asymmetric bento 2fr/1fr added.
twists.spacing: Reduced section padding to 80px. Introduced golden-ratio scale (×1.618): 8/13/21/34/55/89/144px.
twists.interactions: Inversion-swap button pattern: amber fill → cream fill with amber border on hover. Mirrors analog gauge state-change logic.
twists.nav: Flipped iron-chalk dark nav to light. Border-bottom appears only on scroll via opacity transition.
twists.concept: stripe-press publishing/editorial tone → private hydrographic instrument archive. Same object-as-experience philosophy, different subject.
